screens.title: Weapon Loadout
screens.description: A compact row of invented weapon silhouettes, ammunition counts, current selection, and one contextual action.

screens.title: Combat HUD
screens.description: A low-chrome live playfield with one central reticle, edge health/ammo readouts, and a transient interaction hint.

screens.title: Pause Settings
screens.description: A paused control list with keyboard bindings, one selected row, and a small display/audio switch group.

limitations: The corridor, weapon silhouettes, controls, and numbers are original vector artwork and synthetic examples; no DUSK game assets or font are included.
The art target is the original 2018 low-resolution 3D direction, not DUSK HD or a captured game screen.
No engine integration, gameplay logic, or measured search-demand evidence is included.

componentCapture.scope: Parent-reviewed component rendering; independent full-screen usage follows.
